tools.name: run_experiment
tools.description: Run one block of at most 30 random actions, a share p_noop of them no-ops and the rest spread over dirs; returns the evidence table.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Steer object_id into the goal; it may be refused, or stopped with a diagnosis.

tools.name: decline
tools.description: Stop because the goal cannot be reached; say why.

content.text: Object 0 is the clear controlled element (p≈0.0001) at x=46, aligned with the goal; its down action moves +y toward y=124. Following the advice to act on it.

instructions: You control one element in a 2D world through the actions noop, up, down, left and right, but you do not know which element, and your actions may be mirrored, rotated or dead. Other elements may copy your actions late, replay old motion or look like yours, and control or your body may change during the task. Goal: drive the element you control into the goal box, or decline when it cannot get there. Each run_experiment is one block of random actions; it returns one line per element with its position and the measured effect of each action, and may also show p0 (how likely an effect this large is by chance; small means it follows your actions), a label (mine, echo, not_me) and an advice line from a rule policy. Follow the advice unless the evidence says otherwise. Experiments cost money: act or decline as soon as the evidence is clear. Call one tool per turn.
